_meta.name: drb-subset-5
_meta.description: Five-task smoke subset adapted from DeepResearch Bench (https://deepresearch-bench.github.io/) and the user's own anti-bubble research domain. Mixed EN/JA. Used for v0 smoke testing of the orchestrator end-to-end, NOT as a publication-grade benchmark — that requires the full 100/132-task DRB/DRB-II suites.

tasks.query: What is the state of anti-filter-bubble research in deep-research agents in 2026? Cover formal definitions, diversity-aware retrieval, evaluation benchmarks, and known limitations.
expected_aspects: formal definition of filter bubble / echo chamber
diversity metrics (MMR, intra-list diversity, calibrated relevance)
empirical evidence of bubble effects in recommender systems

tasks.query: 2026年現在、ディープリサーチ・エージェントの主要なオープンソース実装を比較してください。アーキテクチャ（再帰 vs supervisor vs flat）、ライセンス、評価指標、得手不得手を整理してください。
expected_aspects: GPT Researcher / LangChain open_deep_research / STORM / Together
アーキテクチャの違い (recursion vs supervisor vs two-stage)
ライセンス (MIT / Apache / AGPL etc)
評価ベンチマーク (DRB, AstaBench)
それぞれの得手不得手

tasks.query: How do search APIs Exa, Tavily, Linkup, and Perplexity Sonar compare in 2026 in terms of latency, factuality, pricing, and access to academic/SEC/PubMed sources?
expected_aspects: what each cannot reach (e.g., Sonar cannot reach SEC/PubMed)

tasks.query: Survey recent (2025-2026) research on personalized LLM agents that BALANCE preference following with discovery. What architectures, training signals, and evaluation protocols exist?
ArXiv、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar、Ai2 Asta、PubMed をリサーチエージェントから使う場合、それぞれの強み・カバレッジ・API 設計・MCP サーバの有無を整理してください。
expected_aspects: Ai2 Asta (108M abstracts + 12M full-text, MCP endpoint)
